text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. Daiichi Ruby's
training progressed smoothly, honing her legs
even further.
choice_data_list: (If there's anything on my mind, it's...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine, not done yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the camp, Daiichi Ruby kept an eye on
K.S.Miracle. Naturally, I kept watch as well, but...
choice_data_list: I wonder if she's hurt or something.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: It seems like she's been favoring her leg this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't appear to be an injury.
It's due to preexisting circumstances...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It's just, during this training camp...
more and more...—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I definitely want to win the Sprinters Stakes,
where I can make the best use of that speed.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And it has to be now...
It has to be right now...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ――...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To be frank with you,
Miracle-san's speed is superior to mine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Throughout this entire training camp,
she never once stopped running—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It looks like her food intake has been cut to the bare minimum, stripping away everything superfluous.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We have shared time together as roommates,
but this is the first time I have ever seen Miracle-san like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
âHoned and refined.
You truly embody the brilliance known as speed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is truly the ideal form I strive for. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby hesitated, which was rare for her. To her, the current K.S.Miracle seemed completely flawless. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san also has a mission,
and she is striving hard to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of that mission,
it seems she's prepared to sacrifice... everything.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san is correct.
...However...
choice_data_list: I wonder if this is really the right thing to do...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I wonder if Miracle herself is really okay with that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that, the conversation ended... but the haze clouding Daiichi Ruby's mind seemed to have cleared. Thus, the summer training camp came to a quiet close.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —...Alright.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm going to step out for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Could she be practicing on her own?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I just got back from training camp, so... I'm just going to do some light exercise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I really just can't sit still, that's all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... right now, I can go further...
reach the next level.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...For that purpose—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I might be late,
so go to sleep without me."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Good night.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Even if I put it into words right now... it won't reach Miracle-san.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure she places fulfilling
her mission above all else.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(If it's for that, I don't mind sacrificing myself.
If now is the only time, I'll bet everything on the present.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I... was the same way.
That's why I can understand everything.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming every obstacle, risking life and limb...
I must fulfill this duty at all costs.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...We are alike.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Bloodline on one hand, a miracle on the other...
They granted us our mission—and an extraordinary talent.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(They're similar, but decisively different.
That difference is...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"At the destination you are heading toward,
you cannot see yourself."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that speed,
there is no future...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I wonder if Miracle herself is really okay with that..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...As if that could possibly be fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "I" will not permit it—
